# Parts library

<!-- Generated by make check. Edit each part.toml, not this file. -->

One folder per part, shared by every build: `part.toml` (identity, dimensions, interfaces, datasheets and evidence), a generated `README.md`, the model (`<id>.step`, and `<id>.stl` for printed parts), `render.png` and fetched `datasheets/`. A build uses a part through its own `<build>/parts/<id>.toml`, which sets the quantity, role, status, systems and assembly mapping and may add build-specific dimensions or interface changes. See [docs/process.md](../docs/process.md).
